name: Malefic Force
effectText:
Target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip this card to it with the following effects.
●The equipped monster is unaffected by Spell effects.
●Once per turn: You can destroy this card, and if you do, add 1 "Malefic" card from your Deck to your hand.
If a card is in the Field Zone: You can banish this card and 1 other "Malefic" card from your GY; destroy all monsters on the field. You can only use each effect of "Malefic Force" once per turn.
